summary: Full backend + frontend test pass on Compass Planning v1. Backend: 33/33 pytest cases pass covering auth, tenant isolation (enterprise vs advisor vs solo), dashboard tier-aware aggregates, enterprise CRM write-block (owners/accounts 403, goals allowed), advisor CRUD flow with progress recompute, advisor roster + drill-down, CRM sync/resync, PIPEDA consent/export/erasure/audit-log/retention, and Solo->Advisor promotion (consent gating, invalid advisor 404, migration counts). Frontend: Playwright verified login for all three tiers, solo Owners add-member + Goals create + progress + Privacy consent toggle + export/erasure buttons + Promotion wizard consent gating (submit correctly disabled until both toggles ON), enterprise Owners page read-only (no add-owner button), CRM resync succeeds with toast. No blocking bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api); starlette applies middleware regardless of order at ASGI wrap-up so this works, but conventionally middleware should be registered before routers/routes for clarity.

server.py `scope_context` for advisor role 'firm_admin' returns filter with org_id only — good for firm-wide reads, but write_scope() sets advisor_id=sc.get('advisor_id') which is None for firm_admin; that means a firm_admin creating an owner produces rows with advisor_id=None, which will be invisible to individual advisors (isolation matches intent, but should be documented).
In-memory repo uses copy.deepcopy on every read — fine for v1 but flag for Mongo migration to avoid perf pitfalls.
audit() serializes `user['scope']` dict directly into audit_log — safe here but consider redacting sensitive scope fields for future PII.
test_credentials: All seeded accounts use password Compass2026! (scott@sweston.ca enterprise_admin, planner@sweston.ca enterprise_planner, firmadmin@compass.ca firm_admin, advisor@compass.ca advisor, solo@compass.ca solo). Bearer JWT from POST /api/auth/login.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — used TEST_ prefixed rows in advisor flow and cleaned them up; solo/advisor consent toggle reverted; solo erasure test flipped retention_schedule to pending_purge for the seeded solo (in-memory, will reset on backend restart).
retention_note: Backend restart re-seeds; if next testing agent needs a fresh state, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_compass_backend.py — reuse as regression. Tenant isolation asserted by scope introspection on every returned row (corp_id/org_id/client_id) and cross-tenant id disjointness. Frontend testids all consistent with app-main, add-owner-button, add-goal-button, goal-save, progress-save, consent-<key>, pipeda-export-btn, pipeda-erasure-btn, promotion-consent-sharing, promotion-consent-reconfirm, promotion-submit, crm-resync-button, open-client-<id>.
